Hardcoded in query/src/test-intelligence.ts and never computed - nothing inspects a test for snapshots or staleness, so these are declared shape rather than measurement. Recorded as a placeholder rather than as an invariant, because `false` here reads to an agent as `checked, and no` when it means `never looked`. This is the EW-3 shape and the honest fix is to compute them or drop them, not to baseline them as properties.

False by construction: an entry exists in this array only because a test was FOUND for the subject, so a per-entry `missing` flag can never be true. The real signal is the sibling `missing_test_candidate` on the selection itself, which does vary.
